content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Security Posture Review - Phase 2 Implementation
agenda_items: Next Steps and Action Item Assignment
Defining Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Security Resilience
Resource Allocation and Budget Projections for Upcoming Period
key_decisions: Formed a cross-functional working group to conduct a comprehensive supply chain security audit within the next two months.
Established a quarterly review cycle for security posture, with the first review scheduled for the upcoming period.
action_items: Finance Director to allocate and ring-fence the approved additional security budget for the upcoming period. (Owner: Mr. David Chen)
CISO to finalize EDR vendor selection and implementation plan by end of next week. (Owner: Dr. Anya Sharma)
